nodes.label: Compare-and-set Update (expect -> conflict)
nodes.rationale: The sheet has no transactions; update with expect under LockService replaces the Postgres 'update ... where state = submitted' guards so two admins cannot approve the same send; a conflict maps to the same 409s.

nodes.label: Row Validation on Every Read (bad rows skipped and reported to admins)
nodes.norm_label: row validation on every read (bad rows skipped and reported to admins)
nodes.rationale: A bad hand edit must never crash a page: the row is left out of member views and scoring and listed for admins as 'Sheet row N: reason'.

nodes.label: Hand-edited owner_name Is a Reassignment
nodes.rationale: If owner_name matches exactly one person, that id wins, owner_id is written back and member_notified_at cleared so the new owner gets a notice; zero or several matches, or an admin, flags the row and leaves owner_id unchanged.

nodes.label: batch Op: Several Steps Under One Lock, All or Nothing
nodes.norm_label: batch op: several steps under one lock, all or nothing
nodes.rationale: A send or a review is two writes, so they must run under one lock with no half-written state.

nodes.label: Per-tab Id Counter in Script Properties (never max+1)
nodes.norm_label: per-tab id counter in script properties (never max+1)
nodes.rationale: A counter means a deleted row's attachments can never land on a new task that reuses its id.

nodes.label: Shared Secret Access (Script API_SECRET == Supabase GSHEET_SECRET)
nodes.norm_label: shared secret access (script api_secret == supabase gsheet_secret)
nodes.rationale: The web app is deployed for 'anyone', so a shared secret held only on the server gates it; a wrong secret gets {error:'forbidden'} and nothing is touched. Browsers never call the script.

nodes.label: Google Sheet as Source of Truth for Task Data
nodes.norm_label: google sheet as source of truth for task data
nodes.rationale: The owner finds Supabase hard to work with and admins sometimes fix things by hand in the sheet, so tasks, sends and buildings live in the sheet; Supabase keeps only logins, invites, files, Ex Docs and notify_log. Performance is not stored but recalculated each time.

nodes.label: Apps Script Thin Row Store (knows tabs and columns, not business rules)
nodes.norm_label: apps script thin row store (knows tabs and columns, not business rules)
nodes.rationale: The script only stores rows; the api function keeps every rule so the tested modules (review.ts, scoring.ts, dates.ts) and the page-facing actions stay unchanged.

nodes.label: Public Repo Rule: Commit Code Only
nodes.norm_label: public repo rule: commit code only
nodes.rationale: The repo is public, so sheet data, the sheet ID, the /exec URL and the secret are never committed; the old system's script stays git-ignored and is never pushed to.

nodes.label: Daily LINE Summary (one message per person, 09:00 Bangkok weekdays, only if non-empty)
nodes.norm_label: daily line summary (one message per person, 09:00 bangkok weekdays, only if non-empty)
nodes.rationale: The bot is on LINE's free plan with a small monthly push limit counted per recipient, so notifications are bundled into one daily summary per person instead of per event; LINE is only a nudge and a failed push must not undo the action.

nodes.norm_label: button d page: reports (activity chart, monthly reports, performance)
nodes.rationale: Activity chart is admins only; members see only their own performance (filtered at the server). Performance scoring note mirrors supabase/functions/api/scoring.ts.

nodes.norm_label: day score formula: 10 if on time, else max(0, 10 - late/3)

nodes.label: Performance scoring rules (1-5 score, raw %, on-time and per-tag scores)
nodes.norm_label: performance scoring rules (1-5 score, raw %, on-time and per-tag scores)
nodes.rationale: Score 1-5 is relative within the team for the chosen period; on-time score loses 1 point per 3 days late; category score = (on-time + average of submission rounds) / 2; only approved tasks whose original due date is in the period count.

nodes.label: All Dates Are Asia/Bangkok Calendar Dates (never UTC toISOString slice)
nodes.norm_label: all dates are asia/bangkok calendar dates (never utc toisostring slice)
nodes.rationale: Sending at 00:30 Bangkok time must count as that Bangkok day, not the previous UTC day.

nodes.label: Architecture: Pure Rule Modules With No Imports + Thin Handlers
nodes.norm_label: architecture: pure rule modules with no imports + thin handlers
nodes.rationale: Business rules (scoring, review transitions, digest text, retention) live in import-free TypeScript modules so plain node --test can run them; thin handler modules wire them to Postgres and Storage.

nodes.label: Performance Scoring (provisional: on-time, accuracy, task score; month and quarter)
nodes.norm_label: performance scoring (provisional: on-time, accuracy, task score; month and quarter)
nodes.rationale: Formulas are provisional, so all scoring rules live in one pure module with tests and only raw dates and history are stored, never precomputed scores. No rounding at any step; only rounds that actually happened count (the old sheet's empty-slot inflation is deliberately not copied).

nodes.label: Task Plan Task 8: Retention With Required Backup
nodes.norm_label: task plan task 8: retention with required backup

nodes.label: Retention: Backup Before Delete (365 days and backed_up_at set)
nodes.norm_label: retention: backup before delete (365 days and backed_up_at set)
nodes.rationale: No file may be deleted without a recorded admin backup; the ZIP is built in the admin's browser because of Supabase free-tier function limits, and deleted files keep their database row so timelines still show them.
